title: [Draft] Complex supplier b ≈ 1.334e-3 (+5.2%): shared-donor kernel and entrance gauges on the E8 complex word
body:
**WIP. The claim is pending the full package and is conditional on two new lemmas.** No κ is claimed.

## Result so far (hosted b on #442's complex word, exact moment engine)
| word | b (·10⁻³) | gain |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| #442 complex | 1.267453 | |
| shared-donor kernel, 79 pivots | 1.310216 | +3.37% |
| entrance gauges, 80 helpers | 1.310916 | +3.43% |
| both (all residuals hosted, stock 7,680) | **1.333854** | **+5.24%** |

If the complex side were the only constraint these give κ caps of 1.3085 / 1.3092 / 1.3321·10⁻³ against 1.2658·10⁻³
for #442's complex word, which is what binds the current frontier (#447, #445).

## What passes
Exact arbitrary-dirt and inverse-transpose replay, the emitted program in both orientations on 800 columns, and the exact
Gaussian phase recipes of every used frame transition, for all three words (`sh check.sh DIR`).

## What does not (read this first)
- The entrance lines are **isotropic** (even weight). The bit-style coordinate-entrance criterion of #440
  (`validate_isometries`) is **not met**; for entrances that do meet it the gain is 0.
- #442's shipped complex audit and emit assume `w == 9` and `start == 0`; no shipped complex word has a nonzero helper
  entrance. The scripts here are patched copies.
- The result is **conditional on two new lemmas**, the review points: (A) the entrance adapter (E→FULL =
  monomial·C_[9−e]·monomial, exact for all 16 entrance frames; the residual-route claim is assumed), (G) nonzero-frame
  compensation and the centre scatter at the target levels (extends #425's conjugation lemma).
- Pending: global template and owner tables for mixed residual widths (the hosted b is a model that reproduces #442's
  complex b to the last digit), finite invoices, the outer assembly with a bit word, mutation controls, byte-for-byte
  regression at the #442 defaults, two fresh replays.
